Description: Transmission of HIV to susceptible individuals from contact with infected individuals in any stage, including those on ART.
Progression from early to chronic HIV infection.
Disease progression marked by decline in CD4 count.
Initiation of ART for eligible individuals with CD4 > 350 cells/ml (e.g., under 'treat all' scenarios).
Further disease progression to a lower CD4 count.
Initiation of ART for eligible individuals with CD4 count between 200-350 cells/ml.
Initiation of ART for eligible individuals with CD4 count <= 200 cells/ml.
Dropout from ART, returning to an untreated state. Models varied on the exact return state and possibility of re-initiation.

Name: CD4 Eligibility Threshold
Description: The CD4 cell count threshold at which an individual becomes eligible for ART, varied across intervention scenarios.

Name: Treatment Access
Description: The proportion of eligible individuals who eventually initiate treatment.

Name: 3-year Retention on ART
Description: The percentage of individuals remaining on treatment after 3 years, excluding those who had died.

Name: Average time to ART initiation
Description: The average time from an individual becoming eligible for ART to starting treatment, corresponding to an initiation rate of 1/year.

Name: Relative Transmissibility (Early Infection)
Description: Factor increase in HIV transmissibility during early/acute infection compared to the asymptomatic chronic stage. Different models used different values in this range.

Name: Transmissibility Reduction on ART
Description: The percentage reduction in HIV transmissibility for individuals on ART, with most models assuming values between 90% and 99%.
